### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/the-british-journal-of-psychiatry/information/about-this-journal/past-titles/past-title/journal-of-mental-science/information/4F51B1E4B3F81774A5D21EE614CDFD45 (publisher record: title published 1858-1962, now continued as The British Journal of Psychiatry)

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.leniency_1_5 / gate / peer_review.type / preprint.allowed**: Journal ceased publishing under this title in 1962 and continued as The British Journal of Psychiatry (Cambridge University Press, on behalf of the Royal College of Psychiatrists). No current publisher policy page exists for 'Journal of Mental Science' itself; any AI/peer-review/preprint policy would properly belong to the successor journal (BJPsych, ISSN 0007-1250 print / 1472-1465 online), not to this ISSN.
- **positioning.accepts_now / methods_welcome / framing_required**: No 2024-2026 articles exist under this title/ISSN since it stopped publishing in 1962 - there is nothing to infer positioning from.
- **experiential.review_time_months / desk_reject_pct / acceptance_note / reviewer_culture**: SciRev, muchong, fabiaoji, zhihu, and r/AskAcademia were not searched individually because a defunct 60+ year lapsed title has zero chance of first-hand submitter reports; any hits found would necessarily be about the successor BJPsych, which is a different ISSN/work order.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- Not queried - journal ceased publication in 1962 under this title/ISSN, per Cambridge Core's own 'past titles' record for The British Journal of Psychiatry, making cross-language forum checks (小木虫/fabiaoji/知乎/Reddit) moot for this specific ISSN; those sources would only be relevant to the successor journal BJPsych under a separate work order.
